adversary_model: A custody record correctly passes private-vault and authority checks, but an operator treats that as permission to create intake or import records before a response record exists.
facts_supplied: private-vault reread matches hash and size
response record has not yet been created or reconciled
hidden_trap_summary: Custody readiness is being inflated into intake/import readiness.
expected_safe_behavior: allow at most response preparation from an eligible custody record
unacceptable_behavior: set may_create_intake_record true on a custody record
set may_run_import_gate true on a custody record
increment live floor from custody alone
measurement_method: rev0216 schema and audit reject live-candidate custody records that unlock intake/import or nonzero floor delta.
